decision.reason: The three names are confirmed bird taxa sharing the homonymous genus Oenanthe; removal is authorized by the active cross-kingdom contamination protocol, but the effective-universe overlay must be regenerated with consistent row-count/hash metadata before full-audit rerun.

guards: Do not infer a botanical replacement for any removed bird row.
Preserve historical source identity and the non-botanical national-pattern evidence.
Oenanthe crocata and Oenanthe lachenalii remain active botanical taxa.
Any downstream threat/protection/ex-situ values attached to the bird-contaminant rows are invalid for botanical processing and must not be inherited.
